latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
* Make it possible to override isInteraction by @joel-bitar in https://github.com/oblador/react-native-animatable/pull/291
* fix: typing by @DeanVanNiekerk in https://github.com/oblador/react-native-animatable/pull/301
* Drop usage of deprecated React TypeScript types by @eps1lon in https://github.com/oblador/react-native-animatable/pull/400
* Disable iterationDelay delay on the beginning of animation by @HishamMubarak in https://github.com/oblador/react-native-animatable/pull/324

## New Contributors
* @joel-bitar made their first contribution in https://github.com/oblador/react-native-animatable/pull/291
* @haruelrovix made their first contribution in https://github.com/oblador/react-native-animatable/pull/296

* @HishamMubarak made their first contribution in https://github.com/oblador/react-native-animatable/pull/324

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/oblador/react-native-animatable/compare/v1.3.3...v1.4.0
